reasoning: Parallel bases form an isosceles trapezoid iff their midpoints share the same perpendicular bisector and lie on different parallel lines. Normalize integer direction with gcd; group by direction and midpoint projection. Within each group keep maximum prior endpoint weight, combine only distinct line offsets. If current shares the best line, a second-best base was already combined when it arrived, so no lost optimum. Exact integer arithmetic, O(n^2) pairs.
